description: This Kotlin source file defines an abstract class 'BrandedFragment' that extends Android's Fragment class and provides branding support such as applying brand colors and customizing menu icons. It includes methods for lifecycle management, theme attribute resolution, and coroutine-based background task execution.

classes.name: BrandedFragment
classes.description: An abstract base Fragment class that manages branding colors and UI adjustments for subclasses.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and applies edge-to-edge padding if attached to an AppCompatActivity.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Resolves theme attributes for colorAccent and colorPrimary, and applies brand main color.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Customizes toolbar menu icons using branding utilities.

methods.name: lifecycleScopeIOJob
methods.description: Runs a code block in a background thread using lifecycleScope and Dispatchers.IO.

methods.name: onMainThread
methods.description: Executes a code block on the main UI thread.
